correctness.rationale: Core computations independently re-verified: census.csv has 1044 rows with correct schema; Euler identity n0-n1+n2=b0-b1+b2 holds on all 1044 rows (0 failures); 0/1044 rows have H1 torsion (SNF(d2) entries all in {0,+-1}); K7 row (atlas 1252: ne=21,nt=35,b=(1,0,20),r=(6,15)) and empty-graph row (atlas 209) correct; RP2 witness facets 012,013,024,035,045,125,134,145,234,235 independently re-SNF'd to d1 diag (-1^5,0), d2 diag (1^6,-1,1,1,-2), ranks (5,10), chi=1, all 15 edges in exactly 2 triangles, all vertex stars size 5 with link degree sequence [2]*5 (5-cycles), connected, H1=Z/2,H2=0,H0=Z; no-collapse proof valid (no free edge since every edge degree 2; no maximal-edge/vertex collapse since every edge in a triangle and every vertex in 5 triangles; exhaustive DFS 1 state correct). SNF->torsion reading is valid because C1=Z1(+)F splits (C0 free) and im(d2) lies in Z1. BUT DRAFT.md reporting is materially wrong on essential distribution claims: claims 58 occupied (b0,b1,b2) types vs 57 in distribution.txt/census.csv; claims connected (b0=1) 411 cases vs 853 actual; claims within connected '267 have b1=0 (195 with b2>0), 65 have b1=1' vs actual connected b1=0:411 (227 with b2>0), b1=1:267, b1=2:132, b1=3:32, b1=4:9, b1=5:1, b1=6:1; claims b0=2:130,b0=3:31 vs actual 145 and 32; DRAFT b0-breakdown sums to 586 not 1044 (internally inconsistent). Minimality bullet overstates: 'Torsion first appears at 6 vertices but necessarily outside flag stratum' is unproved because 6-vertex flag 2-skeleta (156 graphs) were never censused (admitted in limitations); only n<=5 flag (53 graphs) torsion-free plus non-flag 6-vertex example is proved.

originality.rationale: Nearest prior is Adamaszek arXiv:1208.3892 (small flag complexes with torsion, computer-aided classification to 12 vertices) which subsumes the H1-torsion existence question for 7 vertices (H1 depends only on 2-skeleton), plus Chong-Nevo field-coefficient inequalities and chessboard/matching-complex torsion work (different families). RP2 6-vertex 10-triangle triangulation itself is classical (Kuehnel-type), as DRAFT admits. Narrow dataset delta remains: no listed prior publishes the complete 1044-row integral Betti-plus-SNF table with SNF diagonals and greedy-collapse cores for 7-vertex flag 2-skeleta, nor the machine-checked SNF-diagonal plus no-free-face certificate packaging for this RP2 facet list. Treating dataset publication as the claim, there is no substantive prior-table match, so originality narrowly passes; the zero-torsion theorem alone would be a corollary-style rederivation.

value.rationale: Even taking corrected numbers, the contribution is a textbook atlas+SNF enumeration recomputable in ~0.9s with standard libraries, yielding a negative result (0/1044 torsion) with no structural proof, explanation, or conjecture. The Betti histogram (57 types) is reported without distributional insight, extremal characterization, or downstream use; the 1044-row collapse-core census is explicitly disclaimed as rule-dependent raw replay data, not a collapsibility theorem (only witness non-collapsibility is proved, which follows trivially from no free face in a closed surface). The witness object is classical; only its SNF/collapse log packaging is new. This is an unexplained enumeration / parameter census with tiny unmotivated gain that later work would simply recompute rather than retrieve, falling under the reject class even if correct and narrowly new.
